class.name: OcgShapeupgradeRemovelocations
class.brief_description: Removes all locations sub-shapes of specified shape
class.description: ! Removes all locations sub-shapes of specified shape

method.name: Remove
method.description: Removes all location correspondingly to RemoveLevel.

method.name: SetRemoveLevel
method.description: sets level starting with that location will be removed, by default TopAbs_SHAPE. In this case locations will be kept for specified shape and if specified shape is TopAbs_COMPOUND for sub-shapes of first level.

method.name: RemoveLevel
method.description: sets level starting with that location will be removed.Value of level can be set to TopAbs_SHAPE,TopAbs_COMPOUND,TopAbs_SOLID,TopAbs_SHELL,TopAbs_FACE.By default TopAbs_SHAPE. In this case location will be removed for all shape types for exception of compound.

method.name: ModifiedShape
method.description: Returns modified shape obtained from initial shape.
